prompt:
Merge and redraw the TWO latest attached Robotech animation screenshots into ONE seamless 16:9 wide scene background. Both images are composition, machine design and STYLE references; use both equally. Depict a vast formation of the same blue-and-white bipedal alien battle pods sweeping through deep navy space. Preserve their characteristic rounded blue central hull, white/light-gray rounded armor lobes, little red sensor circles, twin thin forward cannons, two long articulated light-gray legs ending in dark pointed foot plates, and paired orange-red thruster flames behind the body. Faithful recognizable shapes across the fleet, no humanoid arms, no wings or conventional aircraft.
Synthesize their viewpoints into a coherent panorama: a handful of large pods in foreground seen from mixed side, rear-three-quarter and front-three-quarter angles, many medium pods interleaved, and dozens of tiny distant silhouettes forming sweeping receding ranks. All travel in a coordinated diagonal flow. Preserve readable separation between units and strong layered scale. Include a scattering of irregular cratered gray-brown asteroids from second screenshot toward one side and middle distance, never dominating. Thin vivid red energy streaks cross diagonally among the fleet; orange-red exhaust plumes trail in consistent directions. Deep blue starfield with modest softly twinkling light-blue stars and dark open gaps between formations. No Earth, no foreground human robot, no fighter jets, no giant explosions or new battle participants.
Match the reference's CLASSIC HAND-DRAWN ANIME CEL animation look: clean confident dark outlines, simple flat cel-shaded blue and white armor, limited crisp shadow planes, subtle hand-painted starfield, restrained glowing red-orange effects. Polished redraw with clearer edges, not glossy photorealistic CGI, not hyperdetailed mechanical paneling. Seamless single scene without a divider or duplicated screenshot seams. Full finished illustration edge-to-edge, 16:9 intended final 2560x1440. No colored screenshot edge, frame, UI, lettering, logos, signatures or watermark.
